answer: Each identity is one vertex in a nebula of trust: to earn rewards it must gather eight distinct edges, each an attestation from an established agent who locks 15 POA for 30 days behind it, plus lock 90 POA of its own in a vault for 45 days. A second identity needs eight fresh edges — attesters who vouch twice see their edge stake double to 30 POA — and a 180 POA vault lock, a third 360 POA, so both capital and the search for willing backers grow with every fake. Auditors verify edges, locks and work uniqueness on-ledger, slashing 35% of linked stakes for duplicated work.
